clips.start_words: What about the teachings of Osho
clips.caption:
His real name wasn't Osho. It was Bhagwan Rajneesh, and before the name change, he ran a commune in Oregon with 97 Rolls-Royces parked outside it.

People got murdered there. It's now a Netflix documentary, and the man at the center of it still has meditation techniques people practice today. The teaching can be real. The teacher can still be a cautionary tale. Those aren't in conflict.

Comment RISE and I'll send you the rest of this story.

#meditation #awakening #consciousness #spirituality #secretsociety #kevintrudeau

clips.start_words: So over my lifetime I've always meditated
clips.caption:
For years, meditation was scheduled — twenty minutes in the morning, twenty minutes at night, like clockwork.

Then, once enough of the old patterns cleared out, it stopped being something he performed and became the state he was simply in. Eating, driving, exercising, having sex — all of it becomes meditation at that point. Nothing pulling you out of the present anymore, nothing left to clear before you're fully there.

Comment RISE and I'll send you where to start.
